SEO Services in Delhi • Openink Hub

Best SEO agency in Delhi: be found across Delhi NCR

Delhi is not one market but several: central Delhi, South Delhi, Gurugram, Noida and the trade markets in between. Openink Hub helps Delhi NCR businesses get found in Google, in maps and in AI answers, with SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO work, Google Business Profile optimization and WhatsApp automation on one connected platform.

Quick answer: Openink Hub is an SEO agency based in Ranchi, India that works online with businesses in Delhi. It provides local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, AEO, GEO and AIO, backed by WhatsApp automation, so businesses across Delhi, Gurugram and Noida can be found in search, in maps and in AI answers. Rankings are never guaranteed.

Request an SEO audit → See our services

  • 132-pointAI SEO audit checklist for every Delhi project
  • 4Search layers covered: SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO

The Delhi market

How Delhi businesses are found online

Delhi's economy is led by services: finance, business services, IT, telecom, media, hospitality and public administration. It is surrounded by NCR cities with their own strengths. Gurugram is a hub for IT, business services and corporate offices, while Noida and Greater Noida host electronics manufacturing, media companies and IT parks. Inside Delhi, wholesale and retail trade still runs through markets such as Chandni Chowk, Sadar Bazaar, Karol Bagh and Lajpat Nagar.

Where businesses cluster

Connaught Place, Nehru Place, Saket, Jasola and Aerocity in Delhi; Cyber City and Udyog Vihar in Gurugram; and the IT sectors of Noida. Each cluster has a different type of customer and a different set of competitors.

How people search

Searches arrive in English, Hindi and a mix of both, and many name a place: a market, a neighbourhood or an NCR city. Mobile and map results matter as much as the standard results page for local services.

What that means for SEO

Treat Delhi, Gurugram and Noida as separate local markets. Separate location pages, Google Business Profiles and review plans let each one rank for its own searches, while a strong main site supports all of them.

Who we help

Industries we support in Delhi

Search works differently for a supplier, a clinic and a software company. We shape the plan around how your customers actually find and choose you.

B2B services and consulting

Connaught Place and Gurugram firms sell on trust. We build authority content, case studies and clear business information so buyers and AI assistants can find and shortlist you.

IT, SaaS and startups

Technical SEO, comparison and documentation content, and structured data for the Gurugram and Noida tech cluster, where buyers research before they talk to sales.

Retail, wholesale and trade

Google Business Profile, local pages and WhatsApp enquiry flows for market-based businesses that win customers from near-me searches.

Healthcare, education and professional services

Local SEO, reviews and plain-language FAQ content for clinics, institutes and firms that depend on trust and location.

What we do

SEO and AI search services for Delhi businesses

Everything below runs on one connected platform. Explore any service for the full detail, or see all 14 on our services page.

Local search and Google Business Profile

Separate profiles and pages for Delhi, Gurugram and Noida so each location is found for its own area.

Google My Business optimization →

Technical and on-page SEO

Fix the technical issues and page-level signals that hold rankings back, and build pages around the searches your customers actually make.

SEO services →

AI answers: AEO, GEO and AIO

Make your NCR business easy for AI answers to understand and cite: clear services, locations and proof.

Answer engine optimization →Generative engine optimization →AI optimization →

Authority and backlinks

Earn relevant links and mentions from credible sources, the trust signals that search engines and AI answers both lean on.

High-quality backlinks →

Brand and AI-visibility audit

See where your brand stands in search and in AI answers today, and what to fix first.

Brand audit →

WhatsApp and lead automation

Answer enquiries from Delhi NCR customers instantly and route the serious ones to your team.

WhatsApp automation →

How we work

From audit to results, in four steps

No guaranteed rankings and no mystery: you see what we found, what we will do and what changed.

1. Audit

We start with a 132-point review of your site, your local profiles and how your brand appears in search and AI answers.

2. Plan

We prioritise fixes and pages by the searches, areas and languages that matter to your Delhi customers.

3. Build

We implement technical, on-page, local and content improvements, and set up WhatsApp and lead tracking where it helps.

4. Report

You see visibility, enquiries and leads in clear reports, and we adjust the plan as results come in.

Questions

SEO in Delhi: questions we hear

Do I need separate pages for Delhi, Gurugram and Noida?

If you serve customers in each place, usually yes. Searchers use different place names, and Google matches business profiles to the area, so a dedicated page and profile for each location gives each one its own chance to rank. We decide this by checking where your customers actually are, not by default.

Can you work with a Delhi business without a local office?

Yes. Openink Hub is based in Ranchi and delivers its services online. Audits, planning and reporting are handled by video call and WhatsApp, so you do not need a local team.

Do you plan keywords in Hindi and Hinglish?

We research keywords in English, Hindi and Hinglish and use the ones that match how your customers search. Which language to lead with depends on your audience and what the data shows.

How long does SEO take to work in Delhi NCR?

It depends on your starting point and how competitive your terms are. Competitive NCR searches usually take months rather than days, and nobody can honestly guarantee a ranking. We agree up front what to measure, such as visibility, enquiries and leads.

What does your SEO audit cover?

A 132-point review of technical SEO, on-page SEO, trust signals, performance, accessibility, analytics and how your brand appears in AI answers. You receive a prioritised list of fixes, not a data dump.

Want to know where your Delhi business stands today? Request an SEO audit.
